wiki_overview.content:
<blog>

# Elastic Janitor: Comprehensive Elasticsearch Cluster Management Tool

## Project Introduction

**Elastic Janitor** is a sophisticated, feature-rich Elasticsearch cluster management tool designed to simplify the administration and optimization of Elasticsearch environments. Built with Python 3.8+, this comprehensive solution provides both interactive GUI-style navigation and powerful CLI capabilities for managing indices, data streams, templates, policies, snapshots, and cluster health.

### Purpose Statement
Elastic Janitor serves as a unified management interface that addresses the complex operational challenges of Elasticsearch cluster maintenance, offering safety-first operations with extensive protection mechanisms and comprehensive automation capabilities.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Safety-First Operations**: Implement multiple layers of protection including dry-run mode, system index protection, and explicit confirmation prompts
- **Comprehensive Management**: Cover all aspects of Elasticsearch cluster administration from basic index operations to advanced performance tuning
- **User Experience**: Provide intuitive navigation through both interactive menus and command-line interfaces
- **Automation**: Enable bulk operations and scheduled maintenance tasks
- **Monitoring**: Offer real-time cluster health monitoring and performance analytics

### Target Audience
- Elasticsearch administrators and DevOps engineers
- System administrators managing production Elasticsearch clusters
- Development teams requiring cluster maintenance tools
- Organizations seeking centralized Elasticsearch management solutions

## Technical Architecture

The project follows a modular, layered architecture that separates concerns between user interface, business logic, and data access layers.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Elastic Janitor Main] --> B[CLI Interface]
    A --> C[GUI Interface]
    A --> D[Core Operations]
    
    B --> E[Command Groups]
    C --> F[Menu System]
    
    D --> G[Connection Layer]
    D --> H[Operation Modules]
    D --> I[Utility Functions]
    
    G --> J[Elasticsearch Client]
    H --> K[Index Ops]
    H --> L[Data Stream Ops]
    H --> M[Templates/Policies]
    H --> N[Snapshots]
    H --> O[Performance]
    
    I --> P[Formatters]
    I --> Q[Helpers]
    I --> R[UI Components]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Core Package Structure:**
- **janitor/**: Main application package containing all functionality
- **janitor/cli/**: Command-line interface implementation
- **janitor/core/**: Connection and Elasticsearch interaction layer
- **janitor/menus/**: Interactive GUI-style navigation system
- **janitor/operations/**: Business logic for specific operations
- **janitor/utils/**: Utility functions and helper classes

**Design Patterns:**
- **Strategy Pattern**: Different operation implementations for various Elasticsearch features
- **Decorator Pattern**: Input validation and error handling through decorators
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic command registration and menu construction
- **Observer Pattern**: Progress tracking and status updates throughout operations

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CLI/GUI
    participant Operations
    participant Core
    participant Elasticsearch
    
    User->>+CLI/GUI: Execute command/menu selection
    CLI/GUI->>+Operations: Process request
    Operations->>+Core: Validate and prepare
    Core->>+Elasticsearch: Execute API call
    Elasticsearch-->>-Core: Return results
    Core-->>-Operations: Process response
    Operations-->>-CLI/GUI: Format output
    CLI/GUI-->>-User: Display results
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Interactive GUI Interface:**
- `run.py`: Direct execution launcher for the main menu system
- `janitor/__main__.py`: Python module entry point for `python -m janitor`
- `janitor/menus/main_menu.py`: Primary navigation hub with categorized operations

**CLI Interface:**
- `janitor/cli/main.py`: Command-line interface with Click framework
- `janitor/cli/commands/`: Individual command implementations organized by functionality

### Core Modules

**Connection Management:**
- `janitor/core/connection.py`: Centralized Elasticsearch connection handling with progress indicators and error management

**Configuration System:**
- `janitor/config.py`: Centralized configuration with security settings, timeouts, and UI preferences

**Utility Functions:**
- `janitor/utils/helpers.py`: Input validation, confirmation dialogs, and interactive selection systems
- `janitor/utils/formatters.py`: Data formatting and conversion utilities
- `janitor/utils/ui.py`: Rich text interface components and styling

### Configuration Approach

**Environment-Based Configuration:**
- Static configuration in `janitor/config.py` with environment variable support
- Security-focused defaults including system index protection and dry-run mode
- Extensive timeout configuration for different operation types

**Dependency Management:**
- `pyproject.toml`: Modern Python packaging with Poetry-style configuration
- `requirements.txt`: Explicit dependency specification
- Optional development dependencies for testing and code quality

### External Dependencies

**Core Dependencies:**
- `elasticsearch>=8.0.0`: Official Elasticsearch client library
- `rich>=10.0.0`: Advanced terminal formatting and UI components
- `questionary>=1.10.0`: Interactive command-line prompts
- `click>=8.0.0`: Command-line interface framework
- `pyyaml>=5.4.0`: YAML processing for configuration files

**Development Dependencies:**
- `pytest>=7.0.0`: Testing framework
- `black>=22.0.0`: Code formatting
- `flake8>=4.0.0`: Code linting
- `mypy>=0.950`: Static type checking

### Integration Points

**Elasticsearch Integration:**
- Direct API calls through official client library
- Support for Elasticsearch 8.x features including data streams and index templates
- Comprehensive error handling and retry mechanisms

**External Service Integration:**
- Environment variable support for secure credential management
- Configurable timeout settings for different network conditions
- Progress reporting for long-running operations

### Component Relationship Diagrams

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Main Menu] --> B[Index Management]
    A --> C[Data Stream Management]
    A --> D[Template & Policy Management]
    A --> E[Snapshot Management]
    
    B --> F[Index Operations]
    B --> G[Index Health]
    B --> H[Index Analysis]
    
    F --> I[Basic Operations]
    F --> J[Advanced Operations]
    F --> K[Cleanup Operations]
    
    G --> L[Health Monitoring]
    G --> M[Performance Metrics]
    G --> N[Diagnostic Tools]
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Comprehensive Index Management:**
- List and analyze largest indices with size sorting
- View index settings and compare configurations
- Detect potential duplicate indices
- Advanced index cleanup with retention policies

**Data Stream Operations:**
- Clean old data streams with retention-based deletion
- Preview deletion operations with dry-run mode
- Manage data stream lifecycle and backing indices
- Optimize data stream storage through intelligent cleanup

**Template and Policy Management:**
- View and manage index templates
- Configure lifecycle policies
- Advanced template management with dependency tracking
- Policy optimization and conflict resolution

**Snapshot and Backup Management:**
- Comprehensive snapshot lifecycle management
- Backup verification and restoration procedures
- Storage optimization through snapshot management

**Performance Monitoring and Tuning:**
- Real-time cluster health monitoring
- Performance aggregation and analysis
- Automated performance tuning recommendations
- Resource utilization optimization

### Implementation Highlights

**Safety-First Architecture:**
- `janitor/operations/advanced_cleanup.py`: Multi-layer safety checks with system index protection
- `janitor/utils/helpers.py`: Interactive confirmation systems requiring explicit user approval
- `janitor/config.py`: Configurable safety thresholds and operation limits

**Intelligent Pattern Recognition:**
- `janitor/utils/helpers.py`: Automatic index pattern discovery and suggestion system
- `janitor/operations/index_pattern_optimizer.py`: Pattern analysis for optimal index partitioning

**Automated Operations:**
- `janitor/operations/bulk_automation.py`: Scheduled maintenance operations
- `janitor/operations/performance_aggregations.py`: Automated performance data collection

### Feature Architecture Diagrams

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing: User Action
    Processing --> SafeCheck: Validation Required
    SafeCheck --> DryRun: Dry-Run Mode
    SafeCheck --> Execute: Normal Mode
    DryRun --> Preview: Show Changes
    Execute --> Preview: Show Results
    Preview --> Idle: Complete
    Processing --> Error: Validation Failed
    Error --> Idle: Reset
```

**Multi-Modal Interface Support:**
- Interactive menu system with breadcrumb navigation
- Command-line interface with comprehensive help system
- Batch processing capabilities for automation scripts

**Advanced Analytics:**
- `janitor/operations/performance_monitoring.py`: Real-time performance metrics
- `janitor/operations/storage_optimization.py`: Intelligent storage management
- `janitor/operations/data_quality.py`: Data integrity and quality assurance

---

**Sources:**
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml)
- [run.py](run.py)
- [janitor/__init__.py](janitor/__init__.py)
- [janitor/menus/main_menu.py](janitor/menus/main_menu.py)
- [janitor/cli/main.py](janitor/cli/main.py)
- [janitor/core/connection.py](janitor/core/connection.py)
- [janitor/config.py](janitor/config.py)
- [janitor/utils/helpers.py](janitor/utils/helpers.py)
- [janitor/operations/index_basic.py](janitor/operations/index_basic.py)
- [janitor/operations/data_streams_cleanup.py](janitor/operations/data_streams_cleanup.py)
- [janitor/cli/commands/index.py](janitor/cli/commands/index.py)
- [requirements.txt](requirements.txt)
- [docs/QUICK_START.md](docs/QUICK_START.md)

</blog>
